WITH winners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ma.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '(blank)') AS bats
  FROM manager_award ma
  JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
),
by_hand AS (
  SELECT bats, COUNT(*) AS managers
  FROM winners
  GROUP BY bats
)
SELECT bats,
       managers,
       1.0 * managers / (SELECT SUM(managers) FROM by_hand) AS share
FROM by_hand
ORDER BY managers DESC, bats;

assumptions.assumption: The inner join to player drops manager awards whose player_id has no match, as the request specifies. Each player_id has one bats value, so summing the per-hand distinct counts gives the total distinct award-winning managers.
A NULL or whitespace-only bats value is grouped under the label '(blank)'. The request does not name a label for this group, so the label is my choice.
